explanation: This function is vulnerable to Cross-Site Scripting (CWE-79) because untrusted input value is concatenated directly into an HTML <div> element without encoding. An attacker supplying crafted HTML or script markup could execute arbitrary JavaScript in a viewer's browser. The repair applies html.escape(value, quote=True) before concatenation, encoding special HTML characters and neutralizing markup injection (the remaining scanner flag stems from syntactic HTML concatenation).
